# MERLOT

> > MERLOT is a curated collection of free and open online teaching, learning, and faculty development services contributed and used by an international education community.

MERLOT (Multimedia Educational Resource for Learning and Online Teaching) provides educators with access to peer-reviewed educational materials, learning exercises, and content builder tools across multiple disciplines. The platform enables searching, rating, and sharing of open educational resources.

## Key Topics

- Educational Resources
- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Learning Materials
- Peer Review
- Overall Rating
- Material Search
- Faculty Development
- Online Teaching
- Curated Collections
- Higher Education
- Multimedia Learning
- Teaching Tools
- Academic Disciplines

## Educational Resource Discovery

- [Material Search Results](https://www.merlot.org/merlot/materials.htm?materialType=3&sort.property=overallRating): MERLOT educational resource search results sorted by overall rating
